name: Jesus
note: The Word made flesh, the Son of God.

name: John the Baptist
note: The witness sent before him.

name: Andrew
note: A disciple of John, then of Jesus, and brother of Simon Peter.

name: Simon Peter
note: Simon son of John, renamed Cephas (Peter).

name: Philip
note: From Bethsaida; one of the first called.

name: Nathanael
note: From Cana of Galilee; "an Israelite in whom is no deceit."

name: Priests and Levites
note: Sent from Jerusalem to question John.

name: Mary, the mother of Jesus
note: Never named in John; she appears at Cana and at the cross.

name: The disciples
note: Those who follow Jesus.

name: The servants at Cana
note: They fill the jars and know where the wine came from.

name: The ruler of the feast
note: The master of the banquet.

name: The Jews
note: In John, usually the Jerusalem authorities, not the Jewish people as a whole.

name: Nicodemus
note: A Pharisee and member of the council.

name: John's disciples
note: Followers of John the Baptist.

name: The Samaritan woman
note: Unnamed, from Sychar.

name: The Samaritans of Sychar
note: A town that believed.

name: The royal official
note: A man in Herod Antipas's service whose son was sick at Capernaum.

name: The man at the pool
note: Sick for thirty-eight years.

name: The boy
note: Gives five barley loaves and two fish.

name: The disciples who left
note: Followers who found the bread of life teaching too hard.

name: The twelve
note: The inner circle of apostles.

name: Judas Iscariot
note: One of the twelve.

name: Jesus' brothers
note: They did not believe in him at this stage.

name: The Pharisees
note: A Jewish movement devoted to holiness and the law.

name: The officers
note: Temple police sent to arrest him.

name: The woman caught in adultery
note: In a passage missing from the oldest manuscripts of John.

name: The Jews who believed
note: People who believed him, then argued.

name: Abraham
note: The ancestor of Israel.

name: The man born blind
note: Unnamed; healed at Siloam.

name: The man's parents
note: Afraid to say more.

name: The people beyond the Jordan
note: Many believed there.

name: Lazarus
note: Brother of Martha and Mary, from Bethany.

name: Martha
note: Sister of Lazarus and Mary.

name: Mary
note: Sister of Lazarus and Martha.

name: Thomas
note: One of the twelve, called Didymus ("twin").

name: The mourners at Bethany
note: People who came to console the sisters.

name: Caiaphas
note: High priest from about AD 18 to 36.

name: The council
note: The Sanhedrin, led by the chief priests and Pharisees.

name: Some Greeks
note: Gentile worshipers at the feast.

name: The chief priests
note: Senior priests who sat on the council.

name: The disciple whom Jesus loved
note: Unnamed in John; later tradition identifies him with the apostle John.

name: Judas (not Iscariot)
note: One of the twelve, listed in Luke as Judas son of James.
